## 3. Findings and what to do

Severity: 🔴 do before Monday · 🟠 do this week · 🟡 note it.

**🔴 F1 — The repository is public.** Anyone can read the code, the RLS design, the seed password and your PROGRESS log. No secrets leaked (checked the whole history), but this is code the client will own (SOW §11). **Do:** GitHub → repo → Settings → General → Danger Zone → Change visibility → Private. Cloudflare Pages keeps deploying (its GitHub app keeps access). Add Deepak as a collaborator if he isn't already.

**🔴 F2 — SOW Rev2 adds things the kit doesn't have.** Expected delivery time, "est. since", per-product delivery override, push notifications, and the 40/30/30 payment split. **Do:** task **R1** this weekend or Monday (push migrations 0008 + 0009 to dev, contract v1.2, decisions D32–D38). Details in `11_SOW_REV2_CHANGES.md`.

**🔴 F3 — `products.details` shape mismatch (hits A1.5, your next backend task).** The seed writes `{"weight":"500g","shelf_life":"10 days"}`; the contract and the mock return `[{label, value}]`. A mapper that passes the object through makes every product's details section blank or crash. **Do:** copy `reference/src/services/supabase/details.js` (+ test, 5/5 passing) into `src/services/supabase/` at the start of A1.5 and use `detailsFromDb()` in the product mapper (A1.5 add-on in `prompts/REV2_TASKS.md`).

**🟠 F4 — A2.3 and A4.2 prompts reference `docs/kit/snippets/…`, which isn't in the repo.** A1.2 copied the dev kit's `docs/` but not its `snippets/`. **Do:** the update kit's `repo/docs/kit/snippets/` restores them (OG functions, image upload reference). Note the known fix already written into A2.3: fetch `/`, not `/index.html`.

**🔴 F5 — Three A1.2 checks aren't recorded on the hosted database.** PROGRESS says migrations were pushed on 27 Sep *before* the `supabase/` folder was copied in, so check that 0007 is actually applied. **Do (15 min):**
```bash
npx supabase migration list          # Remote column must list 20260927000007
```
If 0007 is missing remotely: `npx supabase db push` (it applies only what's missing). Then in the SQL editor:
```sql
select c.relname from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relkind = 'r' and not c.relrowsecurity;   -- must be ZERO rows
```
And run the smoke test with psql (runbook `06` §3 step 4). Write all three results in PROGRESS.

**🔴 F6 — Without a verified domain, real customers can't sign up.** Supabase's built-in mailer refuses to send to anyone outside your project's team, and email confirmation is on (D12). So in Week 3 sign-up works for you two and nobody else until Resend runs on the client's domain. PROGRESS shows the domain hasn't been requested yet. **Do:** ask today (message in `11` §6.1). While waiting, test sign-ups only with your own team's email addresses.

**🟠 F7 — `AGENTS.md` still points agents at the original SOW PDF.** Agents will build the 50/50, "enquiry box", in-app-only version. **Do:** R1 commits `docs/Tibu_SoW_Phase1_Rev2.md` and updates the AGENTS.md lines listed in `11` §5.

**🟠 F8 — DECISIONS D21 ("notifications in-app only") contradicts Rev2.** **Do:** D33 replaces it (push via the settings switch only, with a cut rule). B5.3's prompt line "No browser push permission anywhere" changes too (Week 5 deep dive).

**🟠 F9 — Client templates still say "50%, ₹6,000".** **Do:** use `11` §6.2–6.4 (₹4,800 / ₹3,600 / ₹3,600).

**🟡 F10 — `tibu-prod` was created on 27 Sep and left empty.** Free projects pause after about a week without activity; it will likely be paused by the time you need it. That's harmless (restore it in A5.2). Free organisations allow two active projects, so don't create a third (e.g. a "staging") in the same org.

**🟡 F11 — Build warns about a 580 kB chunk.** Expected while legacy pages and the mock data are bundled; A5.4 (lazy routes) and B5.3 (legacy removal) fix it. Ignore until Week 5.

**🟠 F12 — Tooling has changed.** You now have free Cursor and free Antigravity only (plus Claude.ai chat). The kit assigned reviews to Codex. **Do:** whichever tool wrote a task, review it with the other one (S9), and paste SQL/security diffs into Claude.ai (D2). PROGRESS notes that Cursor doesn't reliably load `AGENTS.md` — always start a Cursor chat with S1 and attach `@AGENTS.md`.

**🟠 F13 — PROGRESS "Now" is stale.** It still says A1.3 is in progress and the last green commit is `73efed7`. **Do:** set it to `5212f7e`, next tasks B1.7 / A1.5 / R1, and add the domain request under "Waiting on client".

**🔴 F14 — The decisions email (`08` §2) hasn't been sent.** Milestone 1's 40% depends on her accepting that "all identified bugs fixed" includes bugs eliminated by rebuilding or removing a screen (D27). **Do:** send `11` §6.1 today or Monday morning. It also asks her to confirm the new M2 definition and the advance-payment question.

**🟠 F15 — Home sellers' exact location would be public.** `businesses.lat/lng` and `address_text` are readable by anyone (needed for distance search). A home baker who taps "use my current location" publishes her home's coordinates. **Do:** D38 — round to 3 decimals (~100 m) when saving, address line optional and labelled public (A4.1 and B4.2 add-ons).

**🟡 F16 — Festival calendar.** Navratri 11–20 Oct, Dussehra Tue 20 Oct (Week 4 — plan 3 working evenings), Diwali Sun 8 Nov (right after launch week). Diwali is the biggest selling week of the year for desserts, gifts and candles, so sellers will want to be live by about 1 Nov. **Do:** aim for production by Fri 30 Oct and real sellers onboarding 30 Oct – 4 Nov (`11` §6.6).

**🟡 F17 — `rls_auto_enable` appears in the function list but not in your migrations.** Supabase creates it on newer projects to switch RLS on for new tables automatically. Leave it; it doesn't affect your policies.

**🟡 F18 — Route name mismatch.** The legacy route is `/notifications/preferences`; the target (B3.4 link, B5.3 page) is `/notifications/settings`. B3.4 should link to `/notifications/settings` and keep the legacy route alive until B5.3 deletes it.

**🟠 F19 — The A4.2 prompt suggests the wrong upload path.** It says "typically `<bucket>/<uid>/<uuid>.webp`", but the storage policy requires the **business id** as the first folder (`owns_business(foldername[1])`, CONTRACT §13). Following the hint makes every upload fail with "new row violates row-level security policy". **Do:** paste the A4.2 add-on from `prompts/REV2_TASKS.md` with the prompt in Week 4.

## 6. Working with only free Cursor and Antigravity

| Kind of task | Write with | Review with |
|---|---|---|
| Multi-file page (B1.7, B1.8, B2.1–B2.3, B3.1, B3.5, B4.2, B4.3, B4.4, B5.1) | Antigravity, planning mode | Cursor Ask mode + S9 |
| Services, hooks, stores (A1.5, A2.2, A3.x, A4.x, A5.1) | Cursor Agent | Antigravity + S9 |
| One- or two-file edits, bug fixes (S7) | Cursor `Ctrl/Cmd+K` inline edit (cheapest) | you |
| SQL, RLS, security questions | Claude.ai chat (paste the SQL or diff; D1–D4) | — |
| Mobile QA passes (B2.5, B5.4) | Antigravity browser agent | you on a real phone |

Quota habits that matter more now that you have two tools, not four:
- Spend Antigravity early in its weekly cycle on the biggest page tasks; keep Cursor for small edits and the end of the week.
- Attach only the files a prompt names. Big vague prompts burn quota fastest.
- When either tool runs dry mid-task: S4 handoff, commit `wip:`, continue in the other tool with S5.
- Free Claude.ai has message limits too. Use it for the things the other two are worst at: reading SQL errors, RLS reasoning, and writing client messages.
